d:
In this AajTak Masterclass, Dr. Vikas Divyakirti talks about the growing obsession with UPSC and government jobs among Indian youth. He explains whether the real problem is the limited number of UPSC vacancies or the increasing number of aspirants.
The discussion also explores career choices, the pressure of competitive examinations, and the importance of choosing the right profession. Vikas Divyakirti shares interesting anecdotes from his personal life, including humorous experiences with his son.
